annotation.bound_parties_text: Member States (which may accept declarations from UAS operators only until set dates) and UAS operators making declarations under Article 5(5) of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/947.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: until 2 December 2023 Member States may accept declarations made by UAS operators in accordance with Article 5(5)
annotation.dates_quote: This Regulation shall enter into force on the twentieth day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union.
